A literal line ending inside a code span folds to a space, per CommonMark

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>see <code>a\nb</code> here</p>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
